limitations: Only the specified separable canonical prolate family and standard zero-temperature Bob amplitude damping are classified. No claim for arbitrary bipartite states, arbitrary channels, average steering-induced coherence, or independently audited novelty.
scientific_integrity: All input states are positive and PPT; the result is a two-qubit theorem using the source definition of single-outcome maximal steered l1 coherence. The proof derives an exact POVM supremum and a strict quadratic positivity criterion. Reproducibility checks are not treated as an infinite proof.
title: Exact reentrant amplification window for maximal steered coherence in separable prolate qubit states
